item.text:
{
  "arguments": [
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.substantive",
      "candidate_id": "node.b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "rule.substantive_conditions", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "Removing the SFC’s requirement on prior approval for material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements, except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"}
      ],
      "inference": "Read item (ii) as requiring home compliance and absence of each independently sufficient exception. This establishes a substantive test, not a determination of actual relief in every procedural circumstance.",
      "inference_id": "inf.substantive",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": [],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"}],
          "explanation": "Home compliance is an express condition of the removal.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.home",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.home_compliance_condition", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"}],
          "explanation": "Novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications each exclude a change. Their absence is not established for any actual change in this packet.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.exceptions",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.disjunctive_exceptions", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "The identified change is evaluated as a whole; the text supplies no express severability rule.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.whole_change",
          "proposition": {"atom": "interpretation.whole_change_assessment", "negative": false},
          "status": "QUESTIONED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.scope",
      "candidate_id": "node.1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "rule.defined_post_authorisation_scope", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "The key streamlined measures cover the following post-authorisation matters:", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u3.575"}
      ],
      "inference": "Apply the circular-specific definition and limit item (ii) to material investment changes in post-authorisation matters.",
      "inference_id": "inf.scope",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.substantive"],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "For this circular, UCITS funds means (i) Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands, and (ii) collective investment schemes domiciled in the United Kingdom authorised as UK UCITS.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"}],
          "explanation": "The express definition supports an exhaustive jurisdictional scope rather than ordinary usage of UCITS.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.definition",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.circular_ucits_definition", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "The key streamlined measures cover the following post-authorisation matters:", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u3.575"}],
          "explanation": "The measures concern post-authorisation matters.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.post_authorisation",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.post_authorisation_scope", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.commencement",
      "candidate_id": "node.ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "rule.commencement_2025_11_28", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "and will take immediate effect.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u1.190"}
      ],
      "inference": "Prefer the specific implementation date to the general immediate-effect wording, while leaving selection of the legally relevant assessment event open.",
      "inference_id": "inf.commencement",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": [],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"}],
          "explanation": "The implementation provision gives an express commencement date.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.date",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.express_effective_date", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "The specific date controls any apparent conflict; the issuance date is unavailable.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.date_priority",
          "proposition": {"atom": "interpretation.specific_date_controls", "negative": false},
          "status": "QUESTIONED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.supervision",
      "candidate_id": "node.1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "rule.separate_item_ii_supervision_condition", "negative": true},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"}
      ],
      "inference": "The purpose statement and express supervision condition in item (i), contrasted with item (ii)'s compliance condition, support declining to add a separate supervision predicate to item (ii).",
      "inference_id": "inf.supervision",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": [],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "These measures aim at facilitating UCITS funds in implementing changes that are subject to their home regulator’s supervision", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u1.190"}],
          "explanation": "The introduction describes an aim, although its reference to supervision leaves a broader-scope reading possible.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.aim",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.home_supervision_aim", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "Removing the SFC’s requirement on prior approval for change of depository and investment delegates which are under the home regulator’s supervision.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u4.653"}],
          "explanation": "Item (i) expressly uses supervision as a qualification.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.operator_supervision",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.item_i_supervision_condition", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "The introductory purpose is not itself an additional item (ii) eligibility condition. The missing FAQs could alter this reading.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.aim_not_condition",
          "proposition": {"atom": "interpretation.aim_not_independent_condition", "negative": false},
          "status": "QUESTIONED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.transition",
      "candidate_id": "node.ea4d19630f8cab09065b1909",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "rule.legacy_application_excludes_relief", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"}
      ],
      "inference": "Infer that preserving the existing approval process also excludes the selected pending application from the new prior-approval removal. This is an interpretive bridge, not an express additional exception in item (ii).",
      "inference_id": "inf.transition",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.commencement"],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"}],
          "explanation": "The transition expressly preserves processing for the described applications.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.preserved_process",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.legacy_process_preserved", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "Unapproved status is assessed at the Effective Date rather than some later processing date.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.transition_snapshot",
          "proposition": {"atom": "interpretation.transition_snapshot", "negative": false},
          "status": "QUESTIONED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "Existing processing preserves the substantive prerequisite and blocks this removal for the selected application. Its duration after a later decision, withdrawal or amendment is unresolved.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.process_bridge",
          "proposition": {"atom": "interpretation.process_preserves_relief_bar", "negative": false},
          "status": "QUESTIONED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.transition_doubt",
      "candidate_id": "node.8eb374ffa546ddd2ba291e37",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "applicable.inf.transition", "negative": true},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"},
        {"quote": "The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"}
      ],
      "inference": "Because processing is the express subject of the transition and the connecting operational provisions are unavailable, the transition does not establish a categorical substantive relief bar without an additional assumption. This does not establish entitlement to bypass processing.",
      "inference_id": "inf.transition_doubt",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": [],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [{"quote": "will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"}],
          "explanation": "The transition expressly addresses application processing.",
          "kind": "ORDINARY",
          "premise_id": "p.processing_text",
          "proposition": {"atom": "text.legacy_process_preserved", "negative": false},
          "status": "SUPPORTED"
        },
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "The supplied packet omits the existing process and FAQ provisions needed to resolve the connection between processing and substantive relief.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.missing_bridge",
          "proposition": {"atom": "record.connecting_authority_unavailable", "negative": false},
          "status": "STATED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.reading_1",
      "candidate_id": "node.00787ab10a284a072204b281",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "model.transition_veto_eligibility_supported_conditionally", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"}
      ],
      "inference": "Combine the substantive conditions, defined scope, commencement and proposed transition exclusion. Support remains conditional on the transition bridge; no actual input facts or approval duty are established.",
      "inference_id": "inf.reading_1",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.substantive", "arg.scope", "arg.commencement", "arg.supervision", "arg.transition"],
      "premises": []
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.removal_eligibility",
      "candidate_id": "node.074087c89e3a3304960f612e",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "model.transition_veto_eligibility_supported_conditionally", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"}
      ],
      "inference": "Separating post-authorisation status from material investment change preserves the same proposed eligibility test. De Morgan's transformation does not create a competing exception rule. The date input still requires a legally relevant assessment event.",
      "inference_id": "inf.removal_eligibility",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.reading_1"],
      "premises": []
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.defined_scope_eligibility",
      "candidate_id": "node.1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "model.transition_veto_eligibility_supported_conditionally", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "For this circular, UCITS funds means", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"}
      ],
      "inference": "The refined scope correctly distinguishes an uncovered fund from an in-scope change failing eligibility. It retains the disputed transition exclusion and therefore does not resolve that uncertainty.",
      "inference_id": "inf.defined_scope_eligibility",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.scope", "arg.supervision", "arg.reading_1"],
      "premises": []
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.restricted_control",
      "candidate_id": "node.4d548f2e09bc36ef51212f64",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "model.nonlegacy_control_supported", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"}
      ],
      "inference": "Restricting the control to post-commencement changes outside the transition permits the substantive test without deciding legacy relief. This is a deliberately narrower control, not evidence that legacy changes fail substantive qualification.",
      "inference_id": "inf.restricted_control",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.substantive", "arg.scope", "arg.commencement", "arg.transition_doubt"],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "The control intentionally abstains on legacy applications and pre-commencement assessments.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.restricted_domain",
          "proposition": {"atom": "model.restricted_domain_intended", "negative": false},
          "status": "STATED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.change_specific",
      "candidate_id": "node.4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "model.transition_veto_eligibility_supported_conditionally", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "except for changes that involve novel or complex product features", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"}
      ],
      "inference": "Assessing features of the identified change and separating the two covered fund categories makes the input relationships explicit. It does not strengthen the inference from any related pending application to a change-level relief bar.",
      "inference_id": "inf.change_specific",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.reading_1"],
      "premises": [
        {
          "evidence": [],
          "explanation": "A pending application must actually cover the identified change; mere relation to the fund is insufficient.",
          "kind": "ASSUMPTION",
          "premise_id": "p.application_mapping",
          "proposition": {"atom": "interpretation.application_covers_selected_change", "negative": false},
          "status": "QUESTIONED"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "argument_id": "arg.time_eligibility",
      "candidate_id": "node.ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94",
      "conclusion": {"atom": "model.transition_veto_eligibility_supported_conditionally", "negative": false},
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "for which no approval or authorisation has been granted", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"}
      ],
      "inference": "The time-based eligibility model follows the proposed transition reading, but a fixed Effective-Date history predicate cannot by itself resolve later decisions, withdrawal or resubmission.",
      "inference_id": "inf.time_eligibility",
      "inference_kind": "DEFEASIBLE",
      "parents": ["arg.reading_1", "arg.commencement"],
      "premises": []
    }
  ],
  "attacks": [
    {
      "attacker": "arg.transition_doubt",
      "kind": "UNDERCUT",
      "rationale": "The source preserves processing but does not supply the bridge establishing a categorical substantive relief exclusion. The objection defeats an unconditional inference, while leaving the expressly assumed transition reading viable.",
      "target": "arg.transition",
      "target_component": "inf.transition"
    }
  ],
  "case_queries": [],
  "cases": [],
  "preferences": [
    {
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"}
      ],
      "over": "arg.transition",
      "preferred": "arg.transition_doubt",
      "rationale": "For conclusions established by this packet alone, prefer arg.transition_doubt's reservation over arg.transition's substantive bridge. Arg.substantive and arg.restricted_control support useful limited determinations. This proposed preference does not establish that legacy applicants receive relief; preservation of an approval process remains meaningful support for the competing conditional reading."
    }
  ],
  "questions": [
    "Do the missing FAQs and existing process preserve a substantive prior-approval prerequisite for legacy applications, administrative handling only, or both?",
    "At what date is unapproved status tested, and how do subsequent approval, withdrawal, amendment or resubmission affect the selected application and change?",
    "Which event determines the legally relevant assessment date? Marking a date input as requiring no judgment does not resolve that legal choice.",
    "Can a home-compliant item (ii) change fall outside home-regulator supervision, and do the FAQs impose a separate supervision condition?",
    "What evidence establishes home compliance and the absence of novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications? Unknown exception facts must not be treated as false.",
    "Can a bundled change be severed, and which application covers each assessed component?",
    "Which existing provisions establish a prior-approval duty when this removal is unavailable? None of the proposed false results independently answers that question.",
    "Should comparison concern actual relief availability or only substantive qualification? The substantive-only and restricted-scope models do not contradict the transition-veto models merely by returning true or no determination on a different control.",
    "What notification and filing provisions apply? Continued post-vetting is express, but the quoted post-vetting sentence does not itself specify a standalone filing duty or deadline."
  ]
}
